effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in its name, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in its name, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
